text:
anna: Quick sync — finalizing invite segmentation and fallback plan for Tue's virtual launch. Main asks: 1) which registration fields are required for routing, 2) RTC fallback plan for participants who can't join Zoom, and 3) transcript sweep / clip priority for post-event deliverables.

mike: For routing: require email, company, job function (dropdown), region (dropdown), and an opt-in checkbox for follow-up. Add a hidden utm_source field.

sara: +1. Also add a free-text field for 'what you'd like to learn' — we'll use that to prioritize demo follow-ups. Keep the form under 6 fields to avoid drop-off.

jordan: For leads: map job function -> SDR/AE queues (startup / midmarket / enterprise). Region -> local reps. UTM -> Campaign owner. Can we add a "priority" tag if they answer "product evaluation" in the free-text?

mike: Yes — we can add a rule: if free-text contains keywords ("P0", "evaluation", "PoC", "trial"), auto-tag priority. We'll also capture session attendance flag.

anna: Good. Next: RTC fallback. We've had EU participants blocked from Zoom—what's our plan?

mike: Two-layer fallback: 1) WebRTC join via our embed (low-latency) as first fallback, 2) if WebRTC fails, redirect to an RTMP viewer hosted on CDN (latency acceptable but read-only). We'll include both links in the confirmation email and a "join via browser" CTA.

sara: Is the embed accessible (keyboard nav + captions)? We need alt-audio and captioning options for a11y.

mike: Embed uses the same Zoom captions SRT ingest; captions will be available in the embed. For alt-audio, we can stream separate tracks for interpretation — but only if we enable in Zoom. We should default to single-track and roll alt-audio only for localized runs.

jordan: For registrants who can't join live, ensure we capture whether they want recording + condensed highlights. Add checkbox: "Send recording" vs "Highlights only". That will drive clip priority.

anna: Perfect. Transcript sweep and clip priorities: propose process: 1) raw transcript auto-generated by Zoom, 2) ML transcript sweep to fix speaker labels + profanity, 3) editorial pass for top clips. Who owns each step?

sara: Content owns editorial. I'll coordinate the clip list. ML sweep — can we run quick NER to surface product mentions and timestamp them? That'll help prioritize.

mike: Deploy-bot: we have a post-run job template `event/transcript-sweep:v1` ready.

deploy-bot: job queued: event/transcript-sweep:v1 for session 2024-05-21-19Z. Steps: ingest SRT -> run speaker-diarization -> NER tagging -> produce clips.json.

jordan: For clip priority: score by (engagement markers + NER product hits + attendee type). Create three tiers: Tier A (sales-ready), Tier B (marketing assets), Tier C (internal review).

anna: Action items: mike -> update reg page with fields + keyword tag rules by EOD tomorrow. sara -> draft clip selection rubric and sample 3 Tier A clips. jordan -> mapping doc from job function -> queues. I'll update the confirmation email copy with join fallback links and the recording preference checkbox.

mike: I'll also add a small script to surface non-joiners 15m after session and ping reps. snippet: `curl -X POST /api/events/3171234567/attendance-check`

sara: Can we ensure captions + transcript are available within 2 hours post-event? That's critical for turnaround.

mike: Agree — infra SLA: captions->S3 within 30m, ML sweep finished within 90m. Combined <= 2h. I'll add these to the runbook.

anna: Thanks team. Last thing: privacy + consent. Make sure the reg page has the GDPR checkbox and an optional checkbox for being contacted by partners. No pre-checked boxes.

jordan: Noted. I'll update the lead mapping doc and add a test row for EU consent.

anna: OK closing — I'll publish the reg page draft in #marketing-drafts and ping Ops to test the embed on Wed at 9am PT. :thumbsup:

mike: Will run a greenroom test at Wed 9:15 PT and validate fallback flows.

sara: I'll prepare the clip selection template and drop examples in the doc.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: greenroom-test at 2024-05-22T16:15:00Z

anna: Great! If anything breaks, thread here.
